scenario: [RFCS.6.7]: the arriving assert precedes everything its evaluation produces, and a fault its propagation raises is part of that. A host assert of an S with a = 1, b = 0 enters working memory, and `r`'s join test `s.a / s.b > 1.0` traps on its propagation (an all-Int division, the only kind that traps [LEXP.7.15.1]), so the activation never forms. The stream holds the input's tick, then its fact_assert, then the computation_error, then the fault fact's fact_assert, then the pump. PATH PINNED: libds's host-assert bridge (wm_rete_bridge.c ds_rete_wm_assert_bridge), whose recorder holds a fault raised inside the hand-off (ds_recorder_hold_faults) until the FactAssert is out; Mercury's `inserted` arm of ds.engine's host assert, held to the same order by the runtime differential (70_match_faults) and test_ds's check_match_fault_node.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    a: Int mutable
    b: Int mutable

rule r:
    S s where s.a / s.b > 1.0
->
    log info "fired"
